test: Exhaust simultaneous S8-conjugacy orbits of ordered four-tuples of double transpositions. Normalize the first image to(01)(23), quotient the other three by its192-element centralizer using successive stabilizers, retain connected support graphs, propagate the four seeds and check every involutory Wirtinger relator. Retain every successful orbit and exact permutation images.
